newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Gujral goes to meet president.
newsitem.headline: India's Gujral goes to meet president.

text.p: The leader of India's United Front coalition, Inder Kumar Gujral, entered the presidential palace on Sunday, witnesses said.
Earlier, the spokesman of Gujral's United Front coalition, Jaipal Reddy, said President Shankar Dayal Sharma was expected to invite the prime minister-in-waiting to form a new centre-left government.

The invitation would follow an agreement between the United Front and its uneasy ally, the Congress party, to establish a coordination committee to improve communication between the political formations and ensure a more stable government.
